args.message:
用户要求继续尝试下载视频。之前所有YouTube直连方案都因IP被Google拉黑失败。现在换完全不同的思路，并行试以下方案：

**方案1：从IGN镜像源下载（非YouTube，可能不受IP限制）**
```
yt-dlp -f "best[height<=720]" -o "/tmp/boys_s5_ign.%(ext)s" "https://in.ign.com/video/254969/the-boys-official-season-5-final-trailer"
```

**方案2：Piped API（YouTube前端代理，内容走Piped服务器）**
先获取视频流URL：
```
curl -s "https://pipedapi.kavin.rocks/streams/UPHz1oUU_J8" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(s['url']) for s in d.get('videoStreams',[]) if s.get('quality') in ['720','1080']]" 
```
拿到URL后用curl下载mp4。

**方案3：其他cobalt公共实例**
```
curl -s -X POST "https://cobalt-api.kwiatekmiki.com/" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Accept: application/json" -d '{"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UPHz1oUU_J8","videoQuality":"720","downloadMode":"auto"}'
```
如果这个实例不行，搜 "cobalt public instances list 2026" 找其他可用实例。

**方案4：you-get工具**
```
pip install you-get --break-system-packages -q 2>&1 | tail -3
you-get -o /tmp "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UPHz1oUU_J8"
```

四个方案并行执行，哪个先成功就用哪个。成功后用Telegram Bot API sendVideo发到用户chat_id（环境变量NANOBOT_CHAT_ID）。bot token在 ~/.nanobot/config.json 的 channels.telegram.token。

预算：每个方案1次exec，共4次。搜索1次（仅方案3需要时）。

args.command:
curl -s --max-time 15 "https://pipedapi.kavin.rocks/streams/UPHz1oUU_J8" 2>&1 | python3 -c "
import sys, json
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
for s in d.get('videoStreams', []):
    q = s.get('quality', '')
    u = s.get('url', '')
    if q in ['720', '1080', '720p', '1080p']:
        print(f'{q}: {u}')
if not [s for s in d.get('videoStreams',[]) if s.get('quality') in ['720','1080','720p','1080p']]:
    print('NO_720_1080')
    # print all available qualities
    for s in d.get('videoStreams',[]):
        print(f\"  avail: {s.get('quality')} -> {s.get('url','')[:80]}\")
" 2>&1
pip install you-get --break-system-packages -q 2>&1 | tail -3 && you-get -o /tmp "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UPHz1oUU_J8" 2>&1 | tail -20

# Try multiple Piped instances
for instance in "pipedapi.kavin.rocks" "pipedapi.smnz.de" "pipedapi.adminforge.de" "pipedapi.r4fo.com" "pipedapi.us.projectsegfau.lt"; do
  echo "=== Trying $instance ==="
  result=$(curl -s --max-time 10 "https://$instance/streams/UPHz1oUU_J8" 2>&1)
  if echo "$result" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('title','no title'))" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "SUCCESS with $instance"
    echo "$result" | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
for s in d.get('videoStreams',[]):
    q=s.get('quality','')
    u=s.get('url','')
    if q in ['720','1080','720p','1080p']:
        print(f'{q}: {u}')
" 2>/dev/null
    break
  else
    echo "FAILED: $(echo $result | head -c 100)"
  fi
done
